summary: This chunk adds new benchmark and eval-0 files for the running-debug-loops skill. benchmark.md reports With-Skill vs Without-Skill results across 3 evals (pass rate, time, tokens). eval_metadata.json defines the vague-login-failure eval prompt and five expectations for a debug-loop fix. with_skill/grading.json shows all five expectations passed for that eval, each with cited evidence. with_skill/outputs/metrics.json logs tool-call counts, files created, and error/output stats for that run. Finally, a new git submodule pointer (project) is added at commit b987a38.

risks.note: Pass rate deltas and time/token stats are presented as summary aggregates with no link to per-eval raw data within this chunk; only eval-0's grading.json is shown here to substantiate any of it.

Evidence strings (e.g. 'git history shows test commit 448b3db precedes the fix commit') describe commits and code not shown in this chunk, so they cannot be independently verified from the diff alone.

least_confident: I could not verify whether the benchmark.md summary statistics (159.8s ± 44.9s, 46996 ± 6055 tokens, etc.) are actually derived from the eval-0 metrics.json shown here or from other evals (1 and 2) not present in this chunk, since only one eval's raw metrics file is visible.
